$comment: Gzip size budgets for the test-mode bundles every pull request builds (VITE_TEST_MODE=true, base /), checked by the first e2e shard in verify.yml after `pnpm test:build` and before its browser tests, so a bundle regression fails before merge. Test-mode chunking differs from the production Pages build, which scripts/bundle-budgets.json covers after merge. Each limit is the measured size plus about 10%. When a change grows a bundle on purpose, build as the shard does (`VITE_TEST_MODE=true VITE_BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter player exec vite build && VITE_TEST_MODE=true VITE_BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter editor exec vite build`), rerun `node scripts/bundle-report.mjs --json --budgets scripts/bundle-budgets-test-build.json apps/player/dist apps/editor/dist`, and set the limit to the new size plus about 10% in the same change.
